title: Recognize agents at a glance
description: Give every agent its own icon and color, then spot it quickly across navigation, chat, and automation pickers.

title: Talk through a task instead of typing it
description: Dictate directly into the composer, or use hold-to-talk on supported desktop browsers, then review the transcript before sending.

title: Shareable sessions
description: Copy a deep link to an agent session so an authorized teammate opens the same working record and context.

title: Save, review and restore agent configuration
description: Edits save automatically as revisions. Review the diff, see what changed, and restore an earlier configuration when needed.

title: Run an Agenta agent with your ChatGPT subscription
description: Connect a supported ChatGPT subscription, select the Codex runtime for an agent, and start a run from Agenta.

title: Control active work across sessions
description: Queue and edit the next instruction, stop or steer active work, switch sessions, and return without losing the working record.

title: Give agents custom secrets without exposing their values
description: Create a write-only project secret, attach it to an agent revision, and inject only the selected secret into its run.

title: Mention a workspace file directly in a prompt
description: Type @ in the composer, choose a workspace file, and place its reference directly in the instruction you send to the agent.

title: Choose a clear permission policy for each agent
description: Choose the agent’s general permission level while keeping explicit tool rules and approval prompts visible.

title: Agenta on Mobile
description: Chat with agents, follow live runs, and approve tool calls from your phone.

title: Slash Commands
description: Control the model and reference skills or tools without leaving the conversation.

title: Automation Runs
description: Review automated work, provide human input, and improve future runs.

title: API Keys Hidden from Sandboxes
description: Agents in a cloud sandbox now see a placeholder instead of your provider API keys.

title: Codex Harness
description: Run your agents on Codex, alongside Claude Code and Pi. Five OpenAI models, local or cloud sandbox.

title: Dark Mode
description: Agenta now has a dark theme. Switch between light, dark, and system from the top bar.

title: Annotation Queues
description: Annotate traces and test sets and turn them into evals.

title: Webhooks and GitHub Automations
description: Trigger webhooks or GitHub Actions when a prompt deployment happens in Agenta.

title: Tool Integrations in Playground
description: Connect Gmail, Slack, Notion, and 150+ tools to your prompts. Execute tool calls from the playground.

title: AI Prompt Refinement
description: Refine prompts with AI in the playground. Describe what to improve and get a refined version.

title: Enterprise Compliance Features
description: Multi-org support, SSO, domain verification, and a US region.
